title: Client bank upload (BOW front end, BANK UPLOAD)
purpose: Each active client's registered bank accounts, primary first, with their status: one line per account, for clients new or changed since the last file. The account number must be digits only, at least 10 (shorter ones are left out and named in the note); the branch is the bank branch's name, or the IFSC when Ledgerline has no branch name. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: BackOffice ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Bank name

columns.name: Account No
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Account number: digits only, at least 10

columns.name: Branch Name
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Branch name (the IFSC when the branch is not known)

columns.name: Status
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. active, inactive or suspended
